faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.intro: Quick answers about credits, prizes and the Wallet website.

items.q: How much does it cost to join a quiz?
items.a: Each quiz shows its price in credits (usually 1 credit ≈ 1 EUR). The entry credit is not refunded unless a technical error is proven.

items.q: How do I withdraw my prizes?
items.a: From the Wallet tab, open the Quilax Wallet website. There you request the withdrawal to your verified bank account. It may require anti-fraud review.
Only on the Wallet website. The mobile app doesn't process cards: this is intentional for security.

items.q: Why do you ask for my ID and a selfie?
items.a: To verify your identity before handling money and to comply with anti-fraud rules. The team reviews the documents; they are not published on your profile.
Yes, if you've played the minimum required number of quizzes. Quizzes go through admin review.

items.q: How is the prize pool split?
items.a: According to the quiz's prize rules (positions and percentages). The live ranking may be approximate; the final split is set when the match closes.

items.q: What happens if I lose connection mid-quiz?
items.a: You may be disconnected from that match. Check the lost-connection screen; once the quiz ends you'll be able to see prizes if you're entitled to any.

whatIsQuilax.title: What is Quilax
whatIsQuilax.body: Quilax is a real-time competitive quiz app. Thousands of players can compete at once in the same match, with the same questions, the same clock, and real prizes in credits.

howAMatchGoes.title: How a match works
howAMatchGoes.body: Every live quiz goes through phases: preparation, reading the question, time to answer, automatic scoring, and partial and final rankings. Everything is synced: no one sees the answer before everyone else.

oneCreditEntry.title: 1 credit = entry
oneCreditEntry.body: Joining costs 1 credit. That credit isn't refunded — it goes entirely into the quiz's prize pool. The more people join, the bigger the pot for the winners.

earlyJoinBonus.title: An edge for joining early
earlyJoinBonus.body: The first 500 to join get a points bonus when they enter (early join). 1st place can get up to +600 starting points; the following tiers also add up, down to spot 500. Joining early matters.

createYourOwnQuizzes.title: Create your own quizzes
createYourOwnQuizzes.body: Once you've played enough matches, you'll be able to create quizzes: questions, timing, category, and date. An admin reviews them before publishing. After you submit one for review, your played-matches counter resets.

seasonsAndRanking.title: Seasons and ranking
seasonsAndRanking.body: There are 45-day seasons with a points-based ranking. You climb by playing well (and joining early). When a season ends, the jackpot is paid out and the next season starts automatically.

creditsAndMoney.title: Credits and money
creditsAndMoney.body: Credits represent real value inside Quilax (≈1 EUR). You buy credits, join quizzes, win prizes, and can withdraw. Every movement is recorded in your transaction history.

secureApp.title: A secure app
secureApp.body: Protected authentication, identity verification when needed, anti-cheat checks on answers, and verified bank accounts for withdrawals. We play fair.

moneyOnlyOnWeb.title: Money only on the web
moneyOnlyOnWeb.body: Buying credits and withdrawing prizes is only done on the Quilax website. In the mobile app you play, search, create, and chat; money moves in and out through the website for security and compliance.

readyToStart.title: Ready to start
readyToStart.body: In the next step you'll create your account with your details. Then you can verify your email, complete your profile, and join your first quiz. Welcome to Quilax!

wallet.subtitle: Buy credits and withdraw on the Wallet website.

notif.body: We recommend turning them on so you don't miss a quiz starting, countdowns (2d · 1d · 2h · … · 1 min), and important updates on the board.
